subject: Three-zone residency & orchestration — scheduling
messages:
From: Ashley Park <ashley.park@aurorafin.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aurora Infra Team <infra@aurorafin.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Multi-region ops deep-dive: EU/US/APAC scheduling

Hi Olga / Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the execs liked the latency breakdown but want a focused technical session on multi-region residency and routing before we lock in a pilot. High-level ask: a 60–90 minute architecture review that covers deployment topology options (EU, US, APAC), data residency guardrails, routing/fallback policies, and a short Ops playbook for failover.

Who should we expect from your side? Our infra folks (cc'd) will bring network and compliance leads. Time constraints: we need this the week of Nov 20–24 (preferably early week due to a regional audit on the 24th).

Possible slots on our side:
- Tue Nov 21: 14:00–16:00 CET / 05:00–07:00 PST
- Wed Nov 22: 09:00–11:00 PST / 17:00–19:00 CET

Attachments: initial tenant topology doc attached for context.

Appreciate a quick confirm of attendees and proposed slot.

Thanks,
Ashley
Ashley Park
Head of Platform Engineering | Aurora Financial
[Attachment: multi-region-playbook-v1.pdf (15KB)]

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ashley Park <ashley.park@aurorafin.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 12:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Multi-region ops deep-dive: EU/US/APAC scheduling

Hi Ashley — thanks for the clear ask and for sharing the topology doc. We'd be glad to run the architecture review and a short ops playbook walkthrough. Proposed plan: 75 minutes total (45 min tech + 20 min playbook + 10 min Q&A). Suggested attendees from our side: Marcus (serving/runtime), Vivek (routing/orchestration), myself (customer success/ops flows).

Proposed slots (all in UTC for ease):
- Tue Nov 21: 13:00–14:15 UTC
- Wed Nov 22: 17:00–18:15 UTC
- Thu Nov 23: 08:00–09:15 UTC (we can offer this for APAC-friendly timing)

If any of these work, we'll share an agenda and a short pre-read (agenda-ops-deepdive.md) and a Google Drive link with model profiles. Can you confirm who from Aurora will own follow-ups on compliance requirements (data retention, logging scope, audit export)? That will help us shape the playbook section.

Best,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: agenda-ops-deepdive.md (2KB)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ashley Park <ashley.park@aurorafin.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Multi-region ops deep-dive: EU/US/APAC scheduling

On Mon, Nov 15, 2027 at 12:04 PM Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Proposed slots (all in UTC for ease):
> - Tue Nov 21: 13:00–14:15 UTC
> - Wed Nov 22: 17:00–18:15 UTC
> - Thu Nov 23: 08:00–09:15 UTC (we can offer this for APAC-friendly timing)

Ashley / Olga — thanks. A couple of bullets I'd like to cover in the tech section so we can tailor any diagrams:
- Preferred topology options (single-master EU vs geo-primary + read replicas) and the tradeoffs for KV cache locality.
- Routing policies: latency-first vs cost-aware — include automatic fallback to low-cost variants and how we preserve guarantees.
- Audit/logging export envelope: how long we retain request-level logs and what redaction options exist for PII.
- Quantization/VM placement implications on performance for short-lived burst traffic.

Vivek: can you lead the routing and failover diagrams? I'll prepare a short slide with kernel/quantization notes. Olga — if they confirm Tue Nov 21 13:00 UTC we'll lock the invite.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Principal Architect | Redwood Inference

From: Ashley Park <ashley.park@aurorafin.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Sat, 20 Nov 2027 16:05:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Multi-region ops deep-dive: EU/US/APAC scheduling

Hi all — apologies for the short delay, we locked down the schedule with our audit team. Tue Nov 21 won't work; Wed Nov 22 is ideal for us. Can you do Wed Nov 22 17:00–18:15 UTC? Attendees from Aurora: myself, Rajesh Patel (networking), Lina Gomez (compliance), and two infra engineers (infra@aurorafin.com).

If that slot works, please send a calendar invite with the agenda and a shared Drive folder. Also, please include any ask-list for pre-reads (e.g., specific latency profiles, expected QPS, sample token sizes) — Lina asked for redaction options to be called out up front.

Confirming: Wed Nov 22 17:00–18:15 UTC works for us. Looking forward to the deep-dive.

Best,
Ashley
Ashley Park
Head of Platform Engineering | Aurora Financial
